title: JUDGEMENT! TO HELL WITH YOUR REPARATIONS!

sense.text:
Jacob “called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.” The time this deals with is the last days, the days we are living in. Jacob understood prophecy: the Lord showed him what would befall his twelve sons, the twelve tribes of Israel, in the last days.

Genesis 49 is talking about the Western Hemisphere. It is not talking about Africa or any other part of the world; it is Israel that would be living on this side of the world. Israel is all over the world, but the Lord put the emphasis on this side because he understood we were going to be enslaved, brought over here on cargo slave ships, and oppressed by the king of Babylon, the so-called white man. It speaks of our people brought here on the slave ships, and of the people who were already living on this side of the world, who came into our land where never mankind dwelt.

Why did the Lord make it like that? Because Judah needed to know who they were first, on this side of the world. Then Judah on this side goes to his people on the other side of the world and every other side, and lets them know what God commanded of them.

“Simeon and Levi are brethren.” Are they not brothers already? It is emphasising that in the last days they will be together. Simeon and Levi are the so-called Haitians and the so-called Dominicans, living on the same island, Hispaniola.

“instruments of cruelty are in their habitations”: that is their witchcraft and their brujeria. “O my soul, come not thou into their secret”: that secret is the voodoo and black magic they do. “unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united”: in the last days Simeon and Levi will not be united. That is why the Haitians and the Dominicans hate each other, why the Dominicans can't stand the Haitians, snatching them up off the street and deporting them.

“Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies.” Two things are said here. Judah is going to be living in close proximity to his enemy, who today is Esau, Edom, the so-called white man; and Judah is going to be fighting with his enemy.

Go back to the '60s and '70s: the Black Panthers, Martin Luther King, Malcolm X, a lot of movements where Judah rose up and was fighting with the so-called white man. “thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.”

“Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion”. This is the '60s, when at one point it looked like Judah was about to do some harm to the so-called white man. “and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?” Christ is going to rouse him up.

“Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea”. This is still what shall befall them in the last days. The ten tribes came over to this side of the world, and this identifies one of them. “and he shall be for an haven of ships”: that is Panama, the Panama Canal. Zebulun is the Panamanians.

“Gad, a troop shall overcome him”. Gad is the so-called North American Indians, and the troop that overcame him in the last days was the US cavalry led by Andrew Jackson. Our forefather Israel, Jacob, was a prophet, and the Lord showed him what was going to happen to his twelve sons.

“Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall”. Joseph is the so-called Puerto Rican. A fruitful bough by a well: they would dwell on an island, and the island is Puerto Rico. Fruitful, because when the Spaniards came they called it port of riches, with gold all over the place and kids playing with gold; and fruitful because the people there multiply, the women are fruitful.

“The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him”: the white man hated him. “But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)”

precepts.why:
What scripture proves that Judah will be living with his enemy, the so-called white man? “come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” Then: “Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.”

Zion is the city of Judah. The daughter of Babylon is Edom, the Caucasian race. So Judah will be dwelling with Edom: that is Judah's hand in the neck of his enemies. He is living with his enemy, and he is going to be fighting with his enemy.

This is the king of Babylon, America. “For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”.

The mount of the congregation is the twelve tribes of Israel, and he sits upon us in the sides of the north. So when we read Genesis 49, it is talking about the tribes on this side of the world, brought here and oppressed by the king of Babylon, the so-called white man.

sense.text:
“And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”. Which Judah is this? There is Judah in Africa, and Judah in other parts of the world, but this is Judah on this side of the earth, in the Western Hemisphere, specifically in the United States of America.

Can the Judah in Africa fulfil this, and go to the people scattered throughout the four corners of the earth? Judah in North America is under Esau, the wicked that controls the world right now, and being under him we can venture out more than the Judah in Africa. With an American passport you can go anywhere in the world. With a Jamaican passport, a Haitian passport, a Nigerian passport, you cannot. That is why the brothers are told to get their passport. This is Judah in America; he is not talking about Judah anywhere else.

“bring him unto his people”: the tribes in Africa, in Japan, in Iran, in India, the Israelites scattered throughout the four corners of the earth. Judah is the one that is going to go and teach them. “let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies”: God is a help to Judah.

The elders in the old school used to explain Judah as the Black Americans and the dispersal. The twelve-tribe chart has been revised. “bring him unto his people” means Judah is going to find who his people are: the prophecy is that Judah will know who his people is. Judah: American blacks, and the Igbo of Nigeria, the Sudanese, Liberians, the Malagasy of Madagascar, Sierra Leone, the Kikuyu of Kenya, the Abayudaya of Uganda, the Falasha of Ethiopia, the Sefwi Israelites of Ghana and more. Benjamin: the Dahomey, the Fon of Benin, the Ashanti of Ghana, Liberians and the Igbo. Levi: the Hausa and others. Ephraim: the Yoruba of Nigeria and the Dalits of India. Manasseh: the Cochin Jews of India. Simeon: the Zulu of South Africa. Zebulun: the Wolof of Senegal. Gad: the Ga of Ghana. Reuben: the Seminole Indians. Naphtali: the Chaga of Tanzania, and the peoples of Southern Africa. This was found by the bishops and the brothers who travel, going into the history of the people over there.

People ask, how do you know that is Israel over there? Because the Lord showed us. The spirit showed us, the Lord guided us, the Lord was a help unto us. Shut the hell up: the scripture says Israel is scattered throughout the four corners of the earth. The chart will keep being updated as the spirit reveals more to the bishops and the brothers that travel. The Lord will show us where our people are, and we will find them and go teach them.

precepts.why:
“The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first”. God is going to raise up the tribe of Judah first: Judah in America.

So when it says “bring him unto his people”, it means the Judah in America will know where God's people are. They are going to find them. Wherever in Africa our people are, we will be able to identify them and find them.

sense.text:
“And they shall fall by the edge of the sword”: we fell by the edge of the sword in 70 AD. “and shall be led away captive into all nations”: we would be led as slaves into all nations. That is a process of time; it did not all happen in 70 AD.

“and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles”: Jerusalem would be occupied by heathens, and that is who the Gentiles are. “until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled”: the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled when Christ returns and destroys the Gentiles.

What were the Israelites doing in Africa? In 70 AD the majority of us fled into Africa. We formed communities, built cities and kingdoms, Timbuktu and Ghana among them, and mingled amongst the Hamitic tribes over there.

The old map Esau drew of Africa, from before slavery, shows it: Elephantine Jews, Hebrews in Nubia, Yemen Jews, Levite cities in Nigeria, Bnei Ephraim on the slave coast, the Dahomey, São Tomé Jews, Judeo-paganism in Senegambia, the Jewish kingdom of Ghana and other Jewish kingdoms, the Berber Jews of the north. And this is not talking about white people. Israel is all over Africa; hundreds of millions of our people are in Africa.

Why did Esau need to know where we were, and draw a map to pinpoint us? Because slavery was not a coincidence. Slavery was war.

Captain Joel found that map in a library, where they had to turn the pages for him, and gave it to the bishop, and now everybody, all the camps, is using it. The spirit did that. Remember the scripture: be a help unto Judah. The Lord makes you find things that point out where the tribes are, so we are not guessing. God helps Judah.

precepts.why:
The Samaritan woman by the well: “Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet. Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.” You say we should worship in Jerusalem, but we worship in this mountain, Mount Gerizim, because our fathers worshipped up here.

“Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.” You are not going to worship in this mountain, and neither will the Jews, the Israelites, be worshipping at Jerusalem.

What is Christ saying? He is saying what we read in Luke 21: we would fall by the edge of the sword and be carried away as slaves into all nations.

sense.text:
“But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”.

A lot of times we leave Deuteronomy 28 at, we came here on cargo slave ships, and bring it out only in our own experience. We have to learn to bring it out on a broad level, because the curses follow the brothers on this side of the world, and on that side of the world, and any side of the world they are on.

Genesis 49 is us on this side of the world. Another way to find the twelve tribes and know who they are is Deuteronomy 28, because these curses follow the children of Israel wherever they are: Africa, America, South America, China, Iran, the Polynesian Islands, Ethiopia, South Africa, India, Iraq, Syria. Wherever you are, if you are an Israelite, these curses will be upon you, and you will be able to identify and relate to them. Write these things down, to use when you teach and when you travel internationally.

“Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people”. When King Leopold colonized the Congo, he took our sons and daughters and made them pick rubber, and if they did not bring back enough he cut their hands off. That is what the colonizer did when he came to Africa.

The sons and daughters given to the white man and brought over here had more kids, and the sons and daughters left in Africa had more kids too, and they were colonized, taught Christianity, enslaved. Why do you think everybody in Africa worships white Jesus? Black people in Africa did not get up one day and decide to. They forced Christianity on them, the same thing they did to us on this side of the world in slavery.

“and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.” We had no might to get them back; all that power was taken from us.

They always want to say black people sold black people into slavery. Don't let them fool you. Who colonized Africa? Slavery was big business. The white man caused division amongst the tribes; tribes warred with each other and took captives, and when they found out what the white man was doing it was too late. There was always a form of slavery, you owe me money and you work it off. But the chattel slavery the white man did to us is something different.

“The Lord shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee”. That is the key thing to watch: the king that you set over you. Were we supposed to set kings over us? By the law, the king is the one the Lord chooses, and that was David and David's seed after him. After the Babylonians conquered us, no king was ever raised up again on David's throne. Zerubbabel was a governor, but we never had a king over us again from the lineage of David.

So when did we set kings over us? Not in the land of Israel. It was when we went to Africa, and when we came to this side of the world: they were called chiefs in North America, and there were kings in Puerto Rico, in Guatemala, and kings set up in Africa. That is why it says the kings you set over you are going into captivity.

“unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.” When you are there you are going to serve the white man. That is where Christianity comes in: the Lord seeing us following Christianity and following Islam.

“The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.” The nations that were amongst us rise above us, and we become the base. Did black people used to have banks? They took the banks away from us. You need a bank loan, anything you need, you go to your enemy for it, to J.P. Morgan Chase, to Bank of America. “He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him”.

There is no such thing as equality. Don't let anybody fool you with that democracy bull crap, all men are equal, equal rights and justice. Somebody has to be on top and somebody has to be on the bottom; we have been assimilated into their society, and they are on top and we are on the bottom. One, two, three Negroes becoming millionaires or billionaires does not change it: you cannot rise above your people, and our whole people is at the bottom of society. “he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.”

Take it to the international, geopolitical level. Do we borrow money from China, or does China borrow from us? China is lending to Africa and to the Caribbean islands, Jamaica among them, and if you don't pay the loans they take your land and your resources. China is lending to Panama and reaching for the Panama Canal. Russia lends to the African nations. And the IMF, the International Monetary Fund, tells Africa what its money is worth and gives the African nations loans they cannot pay back. America and Europe do this to the nations, and our people always have to pay the money back with interest. That is the curse.

That is why Africa is at the bottom of the food chain amongst all nations while the Arabs and the Chinese are rich: most of the people over there are our people, and a lot of the leaders governing those countries are our people. Not all of them are going to repent, but millions of them are Israel. The same is true for the ten tribes over here, in Guatemala, Panama, Ecuador, Argentina, Venezuela, Chile, Brazil. Not everybody there is Israel, the Spaniard mixed with our people over there, but the majority is, and there is a remnant amongst all these places, the elect, who will repent.

“Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed”. No matter where we are, the curses pursue us until our people are destroyed. The reason Africa is at the bottom of society today is that a lot of them over there are our people, and the curses are following them. “because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God”: we did not want to hearken unto the voice of God.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” The curses are upon us for a sign, and for a wonder, for us to wonder why these things happen to us, and they are upon the seed of the Israelites forever.

Why a sign? When you see a McDonald's sign, it lets you know a McDonald's is there. We would be cut off from our heritage, and in the future Judah would need to identify who Israel is. How do you identify the Israelites today? By the curses.

According to the prophecy we would be scattered in slavery and forget our nationality. So God did it real nice: Esau would destroy you in the future and take your nationality from you, but these curses would follow you and your seed, so that no matter where you are scattered, when you read the Bible you say, wait, this is talking about my people. The Most High has them in a trick bag. People say, you know you are an Israelite because of the curses in Deuteronomy 28? Yes, I do. Show me some history books? We have them too.

“Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things”: I would have given you everything if you served me, but you did not want to serve me.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee”: whether it is the white man, the Chinese, the Russian or the Arabs, you have to serve your enemies. “in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”: food, clothing, water, education, anything you need, you have to serve your enemy for it. In America the white man teaches you in his schools and colleges. In the Caribbean islands the educational system was set up by Britain. In Africa the educational system in all these countries was designed by the colonizers.

Africa and the Caribbean islands depend on America for food; we stopped producing our own food. Thomas Sankara refused food aid: it kept them in a beggar mentality, and those who wanted to help should give plows and tractors, not bags of wheat. They could grow their own food. They killed him; his best friend was paid to kill him, became the leader for a time, and later fled to the Ivory Coast. That is the deal the IMF makes: we'll give you two billion dollars, but you can't grow your own food, you have to buy from the farmers in America. A couple of years ago Kenya was rioting because the IMF forced the government to raise the price of the necessities the people need. It is all about control: if you don't agree with what they say, they shut off your food supply. That is how America and Europe became rich.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” This is colonization, and colonization is slavery. They took millions of us from Africa to the Western Hemisphere, but people who say Israel is only on this side of the world are so damn stupid: if they took you as a slave, what happened to your parents, your brothers and sisters that were left over there? The Europeans went into Africa and enslaved them there too, in Ghana, in Nigeria, in the Congo, and brainwashed them the same way they brainwashed us. All these curses happened to our people in Africa. Don't get confused with the term: colonization is slavery.

precepts.why:
Why do the curses need to be upon us for a sign? Because in the future Judah would need to identify who Israel is. “I said, I would scatter them into corners”: we were scattered into corners in slavery. “I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men”: the remembrance of who we are, our nationality, has ceased from amongst men.

We did not just forget who we are because time went on. We forgot because the nations made war with us and took crafty counsel: make sure them slaves cannot read and write. They destroyed us as a people and took our nationality. Ask a Chinese man today who the Israelites are, and he points at these fake people in the land, the synagogues of Satan.

Go to Africa today and you will see millions of people professing that they are the people of God, the Israelites, but you will not see that on the news. Jewish scholars go over there from time to time to try to convert them to Judaism. Just in Nigeria there is a large Israelite community of millions. Over generations of misinterpretations and mixing customs with the Hamitic tribes they bugged out and don't keep the laws the way they are supposed to, but they always knew they were Israel.

sense.text:
Hosea gives the time frame. “For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince”. Without a king goes into political sovereignty: governing your country, making your laws, ruling yourself. When were we not able to govern ourselves? When Europe colonized us in Africa. Before that, we had kings and princes; once they came and conquered us, that was taken away. They took Ghana, Nigeria, Angola, Senegal, Papua New Guinea, the Congo. And the other time is slavery, the transatlantic slave trade, starting for the Negroes in 1619: we were brought here without any king.

On this side of the world our forefathers had kings too, like King Atahualpa, the one they burned. They were forcing Christianity on our people over here, and what they did to our king, they killed him. Christianity is one of the bloodiest religions. Africa had its kings and princes too, many of them.

“and without an image”: you will forget who you are. Our mind was destroyed in slavery, and our mind was destroyed in colonialism, which is slavery. Go to Africa and the sisters blond their hair, put on weaves, bleach their skin, because our image was destroyed. When you worship a God that does not look like you, it does something to your psyche. When you worship the God of your oppressor, it destroys the way you look at yourself and think about yourself.

“without a sacrifice” and “without an ephod” go into religious infrastructure and spiritual guidance: no priest there to tell you what God needs you to do. The white man came and whipped you and taught you white Jesus and his lies, and forced it down your throat in Africa. After he brought the slaves over here, he went to Africa and destroyed them there. That is why a lot of the people in Africa do not know we are the same people, and think the people of the Caribbean islands and America are different from them. That goes back to the yoke of iron upon thy neck until thou be destroyed.

The same curses fell on our people in Kenya, on the twelve-tribe chart. In 1952 the British, who had ruled for fifty years and stolen the best land, rounded up the Mau Mau into concentration camps and tortured them: beating, burning, castrating men, raping women with bottles. They burned the evidence. In 2013 Britain admitted it and paid 20 million pounds to 5,228 survivors, less than 4,000 pounds each, and not one officer was charged. That is why I don't want no damn reparations: you can do that to me and then hold out this money?

precepts.why:
Daniel 12 gives the time frame in which our people would be without a king and without an image. “How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?” The wonders are our people being destroyed, enslaved, colonized, without a prince, without an ephod.

The man clothed in linen “sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half”. A time is a hundred years, times is two hundred, three hundred in all, and an half: 350 years. “and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people”.

When we fled Jerusalem in 70 AD our country was destroyed, but our power was not: we went to Africa and built cities, the ten tribes were set up over here, we still had governments, we still knew we were the children of Israel, we still had kings we put over us. Within those 350 years we were totally destroyed. All that power was gone, and we forgot who we are, even our nationality.

sense.text: “the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria”: we have people in Assyria, and Judah is going to find them. “and from Egypt”: we have people in Egypt, and we will find them. Pathros is Upper Egypt. Cush is Ethiopia. Elam is India. Shinar is Babylon, Iraq. “and from the islands of the sea”: there are a lot of islands of the sea, the Caribbean islands among them. God is going to recover us from all these places.

precepts.why:
How is God going to recover Israel from all these places? “How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard?” How will the people believe unless they hear the teachings of Christ? “and how shall they hear without a preacher?” How shall they hear unless Judah, our people, go and teach them?

“And how shall they preach, except they be sent?” You have to be sent to these places to go teach. That is the mission. The brothers and sisters in all these places have to be taught. We are not going to reach every place on this earth, and the Lord will have mercy on some, but our job is to find the elect, teach them, and show them how to change their life.

There is a small congregation in India. The same way Paul visited the congregations, taught them, guided them and built them up, we have to do the same. People may be watching on the internet in another country and learning, but we still have to go there and teach them, and make sure they are building themselves up.

sense.text:
“Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand”. That is how they destroyed Africa. In 1885, at the Berlin Conference, the Europeans came in and divided up Africa. They whispered in this chief's ear and this king's ear and gave him weapons, then gave this other prince weapons, and had us fighting each other, tribe against tribe, in civil war. That is how they were able to colonize us.

An average African country has over fifty tribes, hundreds of languages, thousands of ethnic groups across the continent. There are the Nilotes, the Hamitic tribes, and the Shemites, and you have to be able to figure out who is who, by culture and so forth, like the Ashanti of Ghana.

Europe is united. In the European Union you can cross from country to country without a visa, live there, and they share wealth, welfare and military so that each country is strong. But when Africa was colonized the borders were carved up: to go from Liberia to Ghana you have to fly through Europe, when you should be able to drive over the border. That is by design, to keep the people divided, because a nation divided cannot stand.

Kwame Nkrumah, president of Ghana, wrote Africa Must Unite, and wrote on neo-colonialism, charting the foreign companies exploiting Africa's resources. That got him removed by Europe and America, and America stopped aid to Ghana. They cannot have Africa united or in control of its own resources.

They always say black people were selling black people as slaves. In 1760 the Ashanti warriors, the Fante chiefs and the coastal leaders of Ghana realized the white man had been tricking them, united, and attacked every Dutch fort at once, and almost ended Dutch slavery. Esau went over there with his ships and coercion, traded guns to the tribes to fight each other, and took the prisoners of war over here. They almost succeeded, but they did not, because the power of the holy people was to be scattered.

After World War II the exploitation of Africa's resources by the Europeans was a far bigger contributor to the recovery of Europe than the Marshall Plan. Why is Africa poor, then? Because of Deuteronomy 28: a lot of our people are in Africa, and the curses follow them. They divide us and they conquer us. Divide and rule.

Look at South Africa right now: xenophobia, the irrational fear, distrust or hatred of foreigners. South Africans are looting the stores of people from Ethiopia, from Somalia, from other African countries; families from Zimbabwe, Malawi and Mozambique fled to a refugee camp; a pregnant woman was chased from a hospital; a Ghanaian working in South Africa was told to go back to Ghana and fix his country. Everybody in Africa is not the same race or the same people, but they are doing it to people that look like them.

It is the same thing Trump and the white people are doing here in America, and the same thing some black people in America are doing: you from Venezuela, you're taking our jobs, this is my country, good, Trump, deport them. Doing it to their own people.

Colonialism does not only steal land and kill those who rebel; it robs a people of self-confidence, so they take on the colonizer's view that they are worth nothing. In South Africa white people own about 72% of the farms, and black Africans own about 4% of the farmland, and the people are beating Ghanaians for taking their jobs. They were under apartheid until the 1990s, oppressed and lynched, and to see them treat their fellow people like that, something is wrong mentally. It is self-hatred, and it stems from colonialism.

“And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour”. That is what goes on in America amongst black people, and in Africa amongst black people: we hate each other and we oppress each other. “the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.”

precepts.why:
“Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad”. When you are being oppressed it makes you mad. The people of South Africa are under oppression: they cannot find jobs, things are hard. But instead of directing that anger in the right place, they direct it at people who look like them: you came from Ghana, from Zimbabwe? You're my enemy. The people that stole your land, occupy your country and hold all the resources, you aren't going after them. That is misdirected anger and aggression, and it is self-hatred that stems from colonialism.

It is no different from black-on-black crime in America. When Zimmerman killed Trayvon Martin and walked around like everything was good, where were all the gangsters and the killers? Let a brother step on your shoes or look at you too long and you will kill him, but your oppressor, no, no, no. It is the same destroyed mind of a slave, here and in Africa. Oppression makes you mad, but you have to direct that anger in the right place, at the colonizer.

AfriForum, the organization that brought the charges that sent Julius Malema to prison for five years, is made up of Afrikaners: white people, descendants of the Dutch, French and German colonizers who built their wealth on stolen land and stolen labor and formalized it as apartheid. They call themselves a civil rights organization, but they were set up to keep black people at the bottom and protect the economic inequality. When the people of South Africa rise up angry with no jobs and no money, these are the people they should direct it at, not our brothers from Ghana, Zimbabwe and Ethiopia.

sense.text:
The United Nations has declared that the transatlantic slave trade was the gravest crime against humanity, in a resolution that also called for reparations, spearheaded by Ghana. Only the US, Israel and Argentina voted against it; the UK and every member of the European Union abstained. The US said reparations should not be paid for things that were not illegal when they happened. The Netherlands is the only European nation that apologized. The so-called Israel ambassador to Ghana said the Holocaust is the biggest crime against humanity, not slavery; if I were Ghana I would kick him out of the country.

Ghana said the African and Caribbean leaders are not looking for money but for the return of their artifacts, and America said no. Yet Trump signed a law for Holocaust victims and their heirs, their descendants, to recover the art and cultural property stolen from them. That is called reparations, for the fake Jews. And Britain now says it will block visas from every country that demands reparations over slavery: Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Jamaica, the Bahamas, Barbados and the rest.

The so-called foundational black Americans say reparations should be for them alone, not for the others who came from Africa. That is narrow-minded selfishness; Ghana gets more props for trying to involve everyone. But to hell with your apology, and to hell with your reparations. I don't want no damn reparations. I want justice. Keep your damn money.

What does the scripture say concerning reparation? “But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth”. All the nations prey on us, and nobody delivers us. “for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.” What does reparation mean? To restore. Nobody says, give these people back their land, give them back their resources, give them back the culture you stole from them. And what is our true culture? We are the children of Israel. They stole our culture, and nobody says restore.

precepts.why:
“Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee”. When the white man came and conquered and took over, the Bible said it is not going to be restored. The white man isn't restoring nothing to us.

The slave owners got reparations. When the UK abolished slavery in 1833 it paid 20 million pounds, roughly 26 billion dollars today, to 46,000 owners. France compensated its owners in 1849. When Haiti won its independence and kicked France out, Haiti had to pay France reparations, billions, and just finished paying it. In America a compensation act gave $300 for each slave to the slave owners. The people that enslaved you, you had to pay them reparations.

That is the injustice of the world we live in: the people who were enslaved and destroyed get nothing, while the slave master is compensated for his merchandise, and Europe says any of you third-world countries that talk about reparations, we are banning your visas.

“If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox”. According to the law, if you steal, you have to restore five times what it was worth. That is the law.

“What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion?” Nothing can be equalled to what we went through. Slavery, the transatlantic slave trade, was the worst crime in history.

“for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?” What happened to us was great, and only the Most High God can heal us from what the transatlantic slave trade did to us.

“And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil”. That great evil is slavery. “for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.”

What happened to us did not happen to anybody else on this earth. So yes, slavery is the worst thing that ever happened: slavery and colonialism, because colonialism is slavery. What the Europeans did to us was never done to anyone else.

“All that found them have devoured them”: all nations have devoured us. “and their adversaries said, We offend not”: they say, we did nothing wrong, that was in the past. “because they have sinned against the Lord”: they say they did not offend, because we sinned against the Lord. “the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers.”

sense.text:
“Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it”: the Lord will order his kingdom. “and to establish it with judgment and with justice”. When Christ returns he is going to establish judgment and justice on this earth. That is what you should be asking for and looking for: judgment and justice.

Black people are running around saying, I want money, I want reparations. The hell with their reparations. What can you give me for what you did to me and my people? It is like somebody rapes your daughter and tells you they will give you five million dollars for it. I don't want your five million dollars; you raped my daughter, I want justice. According to the law, if you rape a woman you have to die. That is justice. And anybody whose daughter is raped and takes that money is an evil son of a gun, one of the lowest people on this earth.

I don't want money. I want vengeance. For slavery, I want justice and judgment from my God. Europe and America are doing what they are supposed to do, because anything they give would not justify what God is going to do to them.

precepts.why:
“Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper”. That King is Christ. “and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.”

All the wickedness, slavery and all of it, the white man is going to pay for, because when Christ returns he is going to execute judgment and justice on this earth. I want justice, I want judgment; I don't want no damn money, I don't want you to pay me off. “In his days Judah shall be saved”: the Lord is going to save us.

“And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.” If you steal a man and sell him, or he is found in your hand, you shall surely be put to death. That is judgment and justice.

Weren't we stolen from Africa and brought here to America, the Caribbean islands and Britain? Yes. Are we still in these lands, found in their hand? Yes. What is the judgment for that? “he shall surely be put to death.” That is called judgment.

“I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name”. This is the Lord's chariots. The house of the thief is those that stole us and brought us here as slaves, those that steal lands and countries: it is talking about America, about Edom.

The chariots, what you call UFOs that you see in these lands, are a curse. The angels are in those things. “and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it”: believe it or not, those chariots are what is bringing forth the destruction.

“For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee”. That is justice. That is judgment. As the nations did to us, God says it shall be done unto them.

“thy reward shall return upon thine own head.” What is their reward? What they did to us shall be done unto them. That is their reward. That is God's judgment and justice.

“The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance”: when you see the vengeance the Lord is going to bring on the so-called white man and the nations for what they did to us in slavery. “he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.”

Brothers and sisters that want vengeance for slavery: to hell with their paper money, you wipe your behind with that. We want vengeance. I want to wash my feet in the blood of the wicked, and the wicked are the people that robbed, stole and murdered us.

“So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous”: that is our reward. “verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth”: the Lord is going to bring judgment on this earth.

All the gold on this earth, everything the nations stole, they are going to bring it all to us when Christ returns. That is the restitution.

“If any man have an ear, let him hear. He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity”. That is the judgment of God: he that led the children of Israel into captivity shall go into captivity. I don't want no freaking reparation; I want vengeance. The people that enslaved me, I want them enslaved, I want them to pay for what they did to my people. “he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword”: weren't we killed with the sword in Africa and over here? God says they must be killed with the sword.

What is this the judgment for? For verse 7: “And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”. Slavery was war. Colonization was war. The white man made war with us, and he enslaved us; that is how he overcame us.

This is the faith of the saints, what you have to believe: “To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people”. The saints of God are going to execute vengeance upon the heathen when my King returns. To hell with your reparations; I want vengeance.

“To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron”: Prince Harry, I want to make him a slave, and his little sons. The same way he made me and my people slaves, I want to make him a slave, and put chains on all their nobles.

“To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints.” The judgment written is, as you have done, it shall be done to you. To hell with reparations. Judgment.
